title: Data Analyst
text: Data Analyst at Talent – Winner ‘Seek Large Recruitment Agency of the Year’ 3 consecutive years! (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: Competitive). Data Analyst NSW Government Client 6 months contract with strong possible Sydney CBD Location Talent International is working in partnership with a large government organisation to assist in sourcing an experienced "Data Analyst' for the online transition project. The role is needed to provide a range of project support and works to the program manager including setting up and maintaining data bases .They also need to create and run reports (for example based on survey collections), and other project reports. Experience required * Demonstrated experience as a process or data analyst within a service delivery environment * Extensive experience and ability to research, analyse and present complex information. * Conduct valid and reliable analysis of sensitive data to produce functional reports which reflect the practice and outcomes achieved by the unit. * Manage and complete data evaluation across multiple projects, adhering to deadlines and ensuring accurate figures are delivered in a timely manner. * Regularly extract and present data to inform external stakeholders and other project staff. * Keep accurate records of data extracted from multiple databases. If you would be interested in this role please submit your application in Word format only by clicking the "APPLY NOW" button below or pinki.verma@talentinternational.com.
